Interface JdkHttpClientConfiguration

All Known Implementing Classes:
DefaultJdkHttpClientConfiguration, ServiceJdkHttpClientConfiguration
public interface JdkHttpClientConfiguration
Implemented by the HttpClientConfiguration subclasses that carry the settings only the JDK client uses, under the jdk namespace of the client configuration: micronaut.http.client.jdk.* for the default client and micronaut.http.services.<id>.jdk.* for a service client. A JDK client given any other HttpClientConfiguration uses the default settings.
Since:
5.3.0
